provenance: Drawn from the engine's own map and Today, exported unedited from a collection built on November 11, 2026: three watches' papers from arXiv, and three searches' from the sources they asked. The papers and the day's runs are real. For the watches' earlier papers, the day each was collected, and so how bright it is drawn, is set from its publication date.

papers.title: AdjointFlow: Accelerating Scientific Inverse Problems with Physics-Based Transport
papers.authors: Ethan Hanold, Nicholas M. Boffi, Qin Li, Leonardo Zepeda-Núñez
papers.abstract_lede: Inverse problems are ubiquitous across scientific applications ranging from seismic imaging to astrophysics to nondestructive testing, yet classical solvers often struggle with nonconvexity and repeated evaluations of expensive physical models.

papers.title: Dark Matters: VAE-Aware HDR Encoding for SDR-to-HDR Video Reconstruction
papers.authors: Donghoon Cha, Bomseok Park, Hansl von Kwon, Ku DoHyung, Hanwool Sul
papers.abstract_lede: SDR-to-HDR reconstruction is an ill-posed problem in which clipped highlights, crushed shadows, and quantization artifacts must be recovered while preserving the original content.

papers.title: Parallel Broyden Methods for Efficiently Evaluating Nonlinear State Space Models
papers.authors: Ian Christopher Tanoh, Scott W. Linderman
papers.abstract_lede: Nonlinear state space models are typically evaluated sequentially, limiting their ability to exploit modern parallel hardware. Recent work has shown that state space models can be evaluated in parallel by reformulating evaluation as a root-finding problem, which can be solved with a parallel form of Newton's method.

papers.title: When to Start Denoising? Adaptive Denoising Entry for Generative Video Compression
papers.authors: Zifu Zhang, Yuqiao Li, Ding Ding, Shengxi Li, Mai Xu, Daowen Li, Kai Li, Ying Chen
papers.abstract_lede: Generative video compression offers a promising solution for compressing and reconstructing videos under extremely low bitrate constraints, among which the diffusion-based solutions still achieve the best performance by providing the powerful generative latent prior.

papers.title: EgoHMP: Achieving Precise Human Motion Prediction in 3D Scenes via Egocentric Cues
papers.authors: Xin Zhao, Pengzhan Zhou, Ziyi Li, Riheng Jia, Zhida Qin, Yu Liu
papers.abstract_lede: The complex interactive dependencies between human behavior and 3D scenes make accurately predicting human intent a major challenge for human motion prediction (HMP). While recent studies use human gaze to infer intent, gaze signals suffer from ambiguity, drift, and a reliance on eye-tracking hardware.

papers.title: Mixed Signals: Weight-Space Programming for EEG and ECG
papers.authors: Dara Varam, Taraneh Aminosharieh Najafi, David Atienza
papers.abstract_lede: Weight-space programming allows language models to read a trained neural network's weights and edit them. This opens the door to ``training'' by reasoning rather than through gradient descent.

papers.title: RB-LDC: Redundancy-Balanced Latent Coding for Noise-Robust Diffusion Latents
papers.authors: Hyunseok Jeong, Jaeho Jeon, Young-Sik Kim
papers.abstract_lede: Latent diffusion models decode approximately correct latents, making decoder sensitivity to perturbations relevant to image quality. After whitening, forward diffusion corrupts every direction at the same signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), despite unequal decoder sensitivities.

papers.title: Location Matters: Sparse Latent-Variance Attacks for Face Privacy against Diffusion Personalization
papers.authors: Shuting Yang, Shuxin Li, Linyan Dai, Xinwei Zhang, Dong Huang, Renyang Liu, See-Kiong Ng
papers.abstract_lede: Text-to-image diffusion models can learn and reproduce an individual's identity from only a few reference photos, creating risks of unauthorized and misleading content generation.

papers.title: From Video Frames to Robot Meta-Frames: A Unified Latent Interface for World Action Models
papers.authors: Guoqiang Liang, Yiqi Lin, Yanzhe Chen, Kevin Yuchen Ma, Mike Zheng Shou
papers.abstract_lede: Pretrained video diffusion models (VDMs) offer a powerful foundation for World Action Models (WAMs), which jointly predict robot actions and future observations. Building such models requires injecting low-dimensional robot signals (e.g.

papers.title: Cognitive Mapping of Learning by Thinking Mechanisms in Large Language Models
papers.authors: Dong Han, Jin Zhang, Kunyue Yang
papers.abstract_lede: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly exhibit capabilities that resemble human Learning by Thinking (LbT), the acquisition of new insight through internal processes such as explanation and reasoning, without new external input.

papers.title: Blurring the Block Boundaries: Overlapping Block Denoising for Efficient Diffusion Language Models
papers.authors: Amir Mann, Jonathan Fhima, Shaked Brody, Or Avitan, Asif Zamir, Shahar Tsiper, Niv Nayman
papers.abstract_lede: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) have emerged as effective alternatives to autoregressive models for latency-critical tasks, enabling faster token generation. Recent advances employ block diffusion with self-editing capabilities, where each block refines tokens iteratively before advancing to the next one.

papers.title: Bayesian inverse problems and epidemic-threshold uncertainty for a heterogeneous SIS reaction-diffusion model
papers.abstract_lede: We study Bayesian inference of persistence from early observations of a heterogeneous susceptible--infected--susceptible (SIS) reaction--diffusion model with standard incidence.

papers.title: Design and Over-the-Air Evaluation of a Digital Twin-Driven Site-Specific Neural Receiver for 5G NR on NVIDIA DGX Spark
papers.authors: Qiuyuan Chen, Chengyang Yao, Liuchang Zhuo, Yuquan Sun, Cunhua Pan, Hong Ren, Jiangzhou Wang
papers.abstract_lede: We design and evaluate a site-specific neural receiver for the 5G New Radio (NR) uplink.

papers.title: Analog quantum approximate optimization algorithm for solving the weighted MaxCut problem on three-dimensional single-atom Rydberg array
papers.abstract_lede: We theoretically investigate an analog implementation of the quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA) for the weighted maximum cut problem (MaxCut) problem.

papers.title: Resilient Integrated Access and Backhaul Network Planning via Graph Neural Network Curriculum Learning
papers.authors: Jie Zhang, Haochen Sun, Mingzhang Zhou, Paul D. Mitchell, Hamed Ahmadi, Qiang Ni
papers.abstract_lede: Integrated Access and Backhaul (IAB) is a key enabler for cost-effective millimeter-wave (mmWave) densification, yet practical deployments are strongly constrained by the spatial availability of fiber-connected IAB donors.

papers.title: Hierarchical Graph Representation Learning with Pooling-Induced Substructures
papers.authors: Luca Sbicego, Xiaowen Dong, Dorina Thanou
papers.abstract_lede: Hierarchical graph-level tasks that require reasoning over substructures that extend beyond local neighborhoods are posing challenges for standard Graph Neural Networks (GNNs).
